#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

class G {
public:
    void submit() {
        int n, k, s;
        long long t;
        cin >> n >> k >> s >> t;
        cout << solve(n, k, s - 1, t) + 1 << "\n";
    }

    int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
        while (t % n != 0) {
            int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * (int)(t % n);
            s = (s + n + delta) % n;
            t--;
        }
        t /= n;

        vector<long long> when(n, -1);
        while (t > 0) {
            if (when[s] != -1) {
                long long period = when[s] - t;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                        return i;
                    }
                }
                throw runtime_error("Assertion failed");
            }
            when[s] = t;
            for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                if (s < k) {
                    s += i;
                    if (s >= n) s -= n;
                } else {
                    s -= i;
                    if (s < 0) s += n;
                }
            }
            t--;
        }
        return s;
    }

    int go(int n, int m) {
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = i;
        }
        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int delta = a[j] < m ? 1 : -1;
                a[j] = (a[j] + n + i * delta) % n;
            }
        }
        return maxDepth(a);
    }

    int maxDepth(const vector<int>& p) {
        int n = p.size();
        vector<int> used(n, -1);
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int cur = 0;
            int v = i;
            while (used[v] != i) {
                used[v] = i;
                cur++;
                v = p[v];
            }
            ret = max(ret, cur);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    void test() {
        for (int s = 0; s < 65536; s++) {
            cerr << solve(65536, 1, s, 1000000000000LL) << "\n";
        }
    }

    void stress() {
        int tst = 0;
        while (true) {
            cerr << tst++ << "\n";
        }
    }

    G() {
        submit();
        // stress();
        // test();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    G g;
    return 0;
}
